item.tib: rgyal ba gnyis pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar pad mo'i 'phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni rgyal ba'i sras po mnyam med 'dul ba rin po che dang / rgyal tshab dam pa rin chen rgyal mtshan de nyid kyi/ zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i mang thos btsun pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ rje nyid la dad pa thob pa'i slob ma mang po zhig gis bskul nas/ bod kyi 'bum 'gyur dus khyad par can la bkra shis khang par chen por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
